book.name: Lɛme
book.title: Ŋwa wu Lɛme chi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso

content: “Bachii bɛ booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, bɛŋ yêgɛ ntanyɛ jwe waŋ a bɛŋ fwe.”
Bo doo bo yu no wu jɛme nyu a jɛ́ yiboo yi Ibulu le, bo mɛsɛ bo chii nɛ nshiiŋ. Bol jɛmɛ lɛ,

“Nle muh wu Bajuu, ba gɛ̀ boyi mɛ Tasu woŋ wù Silisia le, geenɛ ba lɛyɛ mɛ Yɛlusalɛm yanɛ, ŋgɛ n'yɛyi ŋwa chiaaŋ yi Gamala le. Wu yɛyɛ mɛ bɛ banchi ba bachiji besa lɛ chuule mɛ mo nlɛme yi fiɛɛ fì Nyo le ntɛɛme chuule gɛ njɛ bɛŋ bachii ba le fɛnɛ abɛŋ.
Ŋgɛ̀ mboone bikaa a bamii jiŋ ba gɛ̀ bii Jɛ yi Tada le, ŋgee ba yuuyi bo, ŋkoode bilɛŋsɛ bɛ bikɛse ntune yeh yi ncha le.

Finɛ le fiɛɛ, kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ bɛ bamii ba sage woŋ kee chuule. Le bo ba gɛ̀ nya baŋwa lɛ ŋgɛ̂ɛŋ bɛ bo fɛ booŋ ba bwe besa ba Damasku le. Mɛ mo ntu njiɛnyi ŋgɛɛne ki ŋkooyɛ bamii ba bii Je yi Tada le, ŋkaaŋ, nto bɛ bo Yɛlusalɛm ba nya bo ŋgɛ le.
Bol sɛɛŋ no fi gɛ̀ jiɛnyɛ fɛ wu leesɛ fitele yi Jiso le
Ŋgɛ̀ ndoo nfɛɛse Damasku njɛ fɛnshɛ ŋgaaŋ, n'yuu wumu ja wu lalɛ fɛwe, wu shii ye yaŋ le.
Ŋgwe fɛkuu, n'yu jɛ jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ,

content.text: ‘Sol, Sol, wo boone bikaa a mɛ jiŋ nɛ nje la?’

content: Mbiih lɛ, ‘Tada, le wo wù yɛɛŋ?’ Jɛ yiyu chvuu lɛ,

content.text: ‘Le mɛ wù Jiso wu Nasalɛ, le mɛ wù wo boone bikaa a mɛ jiŋ.’

content: Bamii ba gɛ̀ bee besa bo gɛ̀ yɛŋ n'yulɛ wuyu le, geenɛ bo gɛ̀ baaŋ yugɛ jɛ yi muh wù gɛ̀ jɛme besa wu le gɛ.
Ŋka biih lɛ, ‘Tada, taŋlo ŋge nɛɛ?’ Wu chvuu mɛne lɛ,

content.text: ‘Jâ we, wo lêe wo gɛ̂ɛŋ Damasku, ba lé ba sɛ̂ɛŋ wo lɛme chichii chì Nyo le wu seesɛ lɛ wo lé wo lɛ̂ŋ.’

content: Ŋgɛ ja fo, n'yulɛ wɛɛ ge wa nfeeŋ, bamii ba besa bo gɛ̀ jiɛnyi mo bo chiɛɛji wa lo mɛ, bo lee bo gɛɛŋ bɛ mɛ Damasku.
Muh mu gɛ̀ bee Damasku ayu, jee che nyu lɛ Anania, wu gɛ̀ ŋgvuune Nyo chuule wu gɛɛde banchi besa, Bajuu bachii ba gɛ̀ bee yo bo bɛɛŋse wu.
Wu gɛ̀ ja wu to wu yɛŋ mɛne, wu lɛɛŋ mbebe yaŋ le wu jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ, ‘Sol mwa bwaaŋ, wo kâasɛ wu yɛ̂de mwɛɛ le!’ Gɛh segeyu le noo, mɛ mo ŋkaasɛ ntu n'yɛde mwɛɛ le, mɛ mo n'yɛŋ tɛ wu wù Anania le.
Wu jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ, ‘Nyo wu bachiji besa le wu baa wa wo lɛ wo kɛ̂ɛ fiɛɛ fì wu goone, bɛ lɛ wo yɛ̂ŋ Muh we wu Lɛme wu Chaaŋ le, wo yu njɛmɛ wù bude jwe we le.
Wo lé wo gê wo nyû muh wù fêeji kune wu, wo sɛ̂ŋe bamii bachii fiɛɛ fì wo yɛŋ bɛ fì wo yu.
No fi le noo mɛɛse, wo ka chiɛɛne la? Jâ we ba lêesɛ wo a joo, ki ba chûgɛ bimbefɛ biuŋ, no wo lɛge fɛ Tada le.’
Bol sɛɛŋ no Jiso gɛ̀ tuŋ wu fɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu le gɛ
Sege ŋgɛ̀ ntu jiŋ Yɛlusalɛm, ndoo mbuune yeh yi kintanyɛ le, fiɛɛ njɛ kifilɛ ja fi to fɛ mɛne.
N'yɛŋ Tada le a fiɛɛ fiyu le, wu jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ,

content.text: ‘Yâŋsɛ wo jâ Yɛlusalɛm yanɛ chige nje gɛ bamii ba yanɛ nyume bo ge bo bɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fì wo feeji kune mɛ gɛ.’

content: Nchvuu wu le lɛ, ‘Tada, bo kee chuule lɛ ŋgɛ̀ leese yeh yi buunɛ le, ŋkoode bamii ba le bo leesɛ muntele yi ye yo le, nsuŋe.
Sege ba gɛ̀ yuuyɛ Tifiŋ wù gɛ̀ feeji bamii le kune wo, ŋgɛ̀ bee fo, ntoone. Le mɛ wù bamii ba gɛ̀ yuuyɛ wu, bo gɛ̀ baayɛ njú yiboo, bo nya lɛ ŋkɛme.’
Tada ka wu jɛmɛ mɛne lɛ,

content.text: ‘Jâ yanɛ, nje nlé ntûŋ wo je yì ndefɛ le fɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu le gɛ.’”

content: No Bol gɛ̀ jɛme bamii yege, wunɛ jɛmɛ gɛ̀ doo wu bu jwe we le, bo kɛ bo tu bo wanɛ lo fɛwɛɛwe, bo duu lɛ, “Ba lɛ̂ɛshɛ lo kfuu chi wunɛ muh yi nshɛŋ le. Gɛ nyu muh wù nyume yu gɛ.”
Bo tu bo wanɛ noo, bo sɛɛse njú yiboo we, bo nooŋ kibvunɛ we.

Chiji kikwɛɛ ki bikwɛɛ bi bamii ba nchi mo ki ja ki jɛmɛ lɛ nchi jo Bol wu gɛɛŋ bɛ wu fɛ la chiboo le, lɛ bo doo bo gɛɛŋ bɛ wu bo tâaŋ wu, bo bîih mwɛɛ wu le, wu sɛ̂ɛŋ fiɛɛ fì ge Bajuu fɛ bo tu bo wanɛ nɛ.
Bo mo bo gɛɛŋ bɛ wu bo kaaŋ, bo ja lɛ bo tâane, Bol biih kikwɛɛ ki ŋgoo yi bamii ba nchi kimi kì gɛ̀ lɛme fo le lɛ, “Nchi le wu bɛɛŋ lɛ ba taaŋ muh wu Lum njɛ ba sa nsa we sɛŋ?”
Kikwɛɛ ki ŋgoo yi bamii ba nchi kiyu yu noo, ki mo ki gɛ̂ɛŋ ki yɛŋ kikwɛɛ kiboo le, ki jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Wo goone ki wo môŋ nyu la? Wo kêe lɛ muh wunɛ le muh wu Lum.”
Chiji kikwɛɛ kiyu yu noo, wu mo wu gɛɛŋ wu yɛŋ Bol le wu biih wu le lɛ, “Gɛh sɛɛŋ mɛ, wo le muh wu Lum?” Wu bɛɛŋ.
Chiji kikwɛɛ kiyu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Ŋgɛ̀ ŋgu bɛ bige bì duude, fɛ ntu nyû muh wu Lum.” Bol chvuu wu le lɛ, “Nle fiaŋ muh wu Lum, mboyɛ le.”
Bamii baa bo gɛ̀ bee ki bo biide mwɛɛ wu le mo bo chii bikaa fo ki sege, chiji kikwɛɛ kiboo tu wu faane tɛ, nje wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ bo le lɛ bo kaaŋ Bol nyu muh wu Lum.
Bol tanyɛ jwe fwe a bamii ba sage woŋ wu Bajuu

Chiji kikwɛɛ kiyu tu wu goone gɛ̀ ki wu ghedɛ wu kɛ̂ɛ chuule fiɛɛ fì Bajuu gɛ̀ fiɛge yi Bol le. Bvu bu bvu yuu, wu jɛmɛ bo faanyɛ Bol, bo tɛɛŋ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ mo bamii bachii ba sage woŋ, lɛ bo to, wu leesɛ Bol a bo fwe.
